name: Mark Share
tagline: Top rated Real Estate attorney in Los Angeles, California
side_practice_areas: Real Estate, Estate & Trust Litigation, General Litigation
about: Peer-review rated AV Preeminent* through Martindale-Hubbell, Mark Share is a shareholder at De Castro West, in Los Angeles, California. He serves commercial and residential property owners, business entities and executives across the city, offering legal guidance and support on matters involving:
· Buying and selling of homes, multi-family dwellings and retail centers
· Guiding non-U.S. residents through real estate acquisitions
· Managing matters related to construction contracts, mechanic's liens and associated litigation
· Assisting in the establishment of business entities
· Handling probate and trust administration, along with any ensuing litigation
· Safeguarding creditors' rights and assets and expertly handling judgment enforcement and defense
· Spearheading business litigation, including cases among shareholders, creditors and competitors
· Overseeing the intricate process of buying and selling businesses

Mr. Share is an accomplished attorney who obtained his B.A. degree from Reed College in 1986. He furthered his legal education at Northwestern School of Law Lewis & Clark Law School, where he earned his J.D. cum laude in 1990. His dedication to his profession has led to his admission to practice law before all California district courts, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit and the U.S. Tax Court.

During his time in law school, Mr. Share held the position of editor at the Environmental Law Journal. He gained valuable experience by working as an external law clerk for Judge Otto Skopil at the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit. Additionally, he was a part of the Moot Court Honor Board.

Beyond his legal practice, Mr. Share actively engages in several professional organizations. He is a member of The State Bar of California and the Los Angeles County Bar Association. In the latter, he led the Remedies Section twice and was also a past trustee, highlighting his abilities and leadership. Furthermore, he maintains active involvement in the Beverly Hills Bar Association.

Possessing an in-depth understanding of the law coupled with substantial practical proficiency, Mr. Share stands as a reliable legal champion dedicated to providing exceptional representation across diverse legal domains. His steadfast commitment to his clients is underscored by his "Excellent" rating on Avvo.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
